zh.question: 这项实验大概花了多少钱？
zh.answer: 按当前公开多机云租价，论文披露的 14 次主体预训练约合 80–86 万元人民币。若修订新增运行另计，约为 86–92 万元。作者未公布实际账单，数据生成、后训练、评价及人工费用还需另计。
zh.detail_label: 展开 GPU 小时、单价和费用边界
zh.detail:
这是按公开租价推算的预训练费用。论文附录 E.1 报告每次约 1,380 H200 GPU 小时，或 850 B200 GPU 小时，并写明训练了 14 个 1B 模型。GPU 小时已经是所有卡时的合计，换算费用时无需再乘节点数或每节点卡数。

2026 年 11 月 20 日查到的 Runpod 多机 Clusters 标价为 H200 每 GPU 小时 6.35 美元、B200 每 GPU 小时 9.59 美元。假设能达到论文报告的训练效率，计算如下。

| 方案 | 单次预训练美元 | 14 次预训练美元 | 按 1 美元 = 7 元估算人民币 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| H200，1,380 GPU 小时 | 8,763 | 122,682 | 858,774 |
| B200，850 GPU 小时 | 8,151.50 | 114,121 | 798,847 |

两行是替代方案。人民币换算中的 7 是便于理解的估算假设。价格为当前公开标价，实际历史合同、机构集群和资助额度都可能改变作者的现金支出。

**修订新增运行。** 附录 H 报告无条件合成组为一个训练种子，而附录 E.1 仍写 14 个模型。两处没有明确对账。如果新增组在 14 次之外，按相同耗时估算再加约 5.7 万至 6.1 万元，总预训练折算约 85.6 万至 92.0 万元。

**完整项目还有哪些费用？** 真实书籍的筛选和清洗、约 6B token 的条件合成生成、无条件生成、各组 SFT 与 DPO、批量推理、GPT-4.1 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 等裁判调用、来源审计、存储和人工评审。论文未给出这些环节的完整 GPU 小时、调用账单与人工成本，无法可靠加成一个全项目总价。上表也未加税费、空转与失败重跑。

来源：[论文附录 E.1，PDF 第 32 页](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=NpBFkL2BTm#page=32)、[附录 H，PDF 第 39 页](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=NpBFkL2BTm#page=39)、[Runpod Clusters 标价](https://www.runpod.io/pricing)、[Runpod 多机训练说明](https://www.runpod.io/articles/guides/multi-node-distributed-training)。

en.question: Approximately how much did the experiments cost?
en.answer: At current public multi-node rental prices, the stated 14 main pretraining runs are equivalent to about CNY 800,000–860,000. If the added revised run is separate, the estimate rises to CNY 860,000–920,000. The actual bill and additional data generation, post-training, evaluation, and labor costs are not reported.
en.detail_label: Expand GPU-hours, rates, and cost scope
en.detail:
This estimates the rental-equivalent cost of pretraining. Appendix E.1 reports approximately 1,380 H200 GPU-hours or 850 B200 GPU-hours per run and states that 14 1B models were trained. GPU-hours already sum time across the GPUs. No additional multiplication by node or GPU count is needed.

On November 20, 2026, Runpod listed multi-node Clusters at USD 6.35 per H200 GPU-hour and USD 9.59 per B200 GPU-hour. Assuming the training efficiency reported in the paper, the arithmetic is as follows.

| Option | USD per pretraining run | USD for 14 runs | CNY assuming USD 1 = CNY 7 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| H200, 1,380 GPU-hours | 8,763 | 122,682 | 858,774 |
| B200, 850 GPU-hours | 8,151.50 | 114,121 | 798,847 |

The rows are alternative hardware scenarios. The CNY conversion uses 7 as an illustrative assumption. These are current public list prices. Historical contracts, institutional infrastructure, and credits could change the authors' cash outlay.

**Additional revised run.** Appendix H reports one training seed for the unconditioned synthetic model, while Appendix E.1 still states 14 models. The accounting is not explicitly reconciled. If that run is additional, matching the reported training time would add approximately CNY 57,000 to 61,000, bringing pretraining to approximately CNY 856,000 to 920,000.

**Other project costs.** These include selecting and cleaning books, generating approximately 6B tokens of conditioned text and the unconditioned corpus, SFT and DPO, evaluation inference, GPT-4.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 judge calls, provenance attacks, storage, and human evaluation. The paper does not give complete GPU-hours, bills, or labor costs for these stages, so a reliable all-in project total cannot be calculated. The table also excludes taxes, idle time, and failed reruns.

Sources: [Appendix E.1, PDF page 32](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=NpBFkL2BTm#page=32), [Appendix H, PDF page 39](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=NpBFkL2BTm#page=39), [Runpod Clusters prices](https://www.runpod.io/pricing), and [Runpod multi-node training guide](https://www.runpod.io/articles/guides/multi-node-distributed-training).
